title: Jobs picked up from 6 Defu South St 1 #05-24 (uParcel warehouse)
keywords: warehouse job defu 05-24 denzel expired cancel
body: Any job picked up from 6 Defu South St 1 #05-24 is a uParcel warehouse job, whatever customer name is on it.
If a warehouse job expires or is not accepted, flag it at once to the Ops team, the Fulfilment team or Denzel.
